offering_description.value: Alight administers health, retirement and leave benefits for employers and public-sector plan sponsors. It combines a cloud platform for enrollment and account access with outsourced recordkeeping, benefits navigation and participant support. Its retiree marketplace helps individuals compare and enroll in Medicare plans.

primary_products.value: Cloud software for employee benefits enrollment, plan administration and participant self-service

primary_services.value: Health and welfare benefits administration; retirement plan recordkeeping and administration; leave and disability administration; healthcare navigation; retiree Medicare plan brokerage

customer_segment.value: B2B: Large and mid-sized employers and private-sector benefit plan sponsors; B2G: Public-sector retirement plan sponsors; B2C: Retirees and other Medicare-eligible individuals shopping for coverage

end_markets.value: Employer-sponsored health and welfare benefits; workplace retirement; employee leave and disability; retiree health insurance

revenue_model.value: service fees: Recurring fees for benefits administration, recordkeeping, platform access and participant support; project or contract: Implementation and transition work for employer benefit programs; commissions or management fees: Insurer commissions on Medicare plan enrollments
revenue_model.category: service fees; project or contract; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Uses employer plan rules and participant records to administer benefits for plan sponsors; software / platform: Uses plan and eligibility data to provide enrollment and account tools for employers and participants; financial intermediary: Uses insurer plan information to broker Medicare coverage for eligible individuals
value_chain_position.category: service provider; software / platform; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: global: Primarily serves the United States, with service delivery operations in India

specialization.value: related lines: Health benefits, retirement plans, leave and disability, healthcare navigation and retiree Medicare coverage

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Enterprise sales teams serving employers and plan sponsors; online: Employer-sponsored benefits portals and an online Medicare marketplace; agents / brokers: Licensed insurance agents assisting Medicare shoppers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Benefits administration subject to ERISA and HIPAA where applicable, with Medicare brokerage subject to CMS and state licensing rules

notes: The benefits platform is bundled with administration, and standalone software sales are uncertain.
